protocol:
Opponent-play labels. Events come from the deploy stopwatch, not from YOLO: every
troop/building play shows a gold-rimmed stopwatch at the deploy point whose face
fills RED for the opponent (BLUE for us) over the deploy time. /tmp/opp/watch.py
(Hough circle + ring/face colour test, 4 Hz frames) finds them; consecutive
detections are merged into one event (same place, gaps <= 0.75 s). frame = first
frame the watch is seen (+-0.25 s at 4 Hz), ref = watch centre (549x976 ref px),
tile_yolo = video_dataset/detector/common.ref_to_tile(ref), tile_engine = (x, live_ppo/tile_map.det_to_engine_y(y, "tower")) -- the project's tower-anchored row map (identity to det row 13, +1 on 14-17, +2 from 18).
tier "gold": every event in the match was checked by eye on zoomed filmstrips
(-> side, false watch hits removed, card named only when readable by eye, else "?").
tier "silver": unverified events with >= 2 red detections (label precision measured
on the gold matches). Spells have no stopwatch: on gold matches with
spells_labelled, spell plays were added by eye from YOLO spell-track candidates
and blind sheet review (id_source / src_event say which); spell recall is
therefore relative to what either source surfaced.
